name: Rao's Homemade Sensitive Formula Marinara (No Onion, No Garlic)
whyItWorks: Crafted specifically for sensitive digestion: slow-simmered whole Italian peeled tomatoes, olive oil, basil, and sea salt with ABSOLUTELY NO ONION and NO GARLIC. The skins and seeds are strained out, leaving pure velvety tomato comfort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in a saucepan and ladle over white pasta, grilled chicken, or baked polenta.
watchOuts: Top recommendation for gut-safe Italian pasta meals.
